body_lead: Thiruvananthapuram, Aug 4 (PTI) The Kerala government has launched a sweeping overhaul of its administrative machinery, introducing AI-assisted governance, digital public service delivery, faster land acquisition, deregulation and integrated planning systems as part of a broader effort to modernise the state’s bureaucracy and improve ease of doing business and ease of living.
